dependencies_note: Catalog lists IMP-0321 and IMP-0306. Those modules are participation and consent/veto surfaces. This unit ships a builder-local stopping tree and does not wait on them.

evidence.claim: All five owner goals build; each stopping expression is printed; canonical_shape matches the catalog oracle.

stopping_expressions.restate: Stop when unique_ideas >= 100. Owner phrasing: brainstorm until 100 unique ideas. Goal id: G1.

stopping_expressions.phrasing: argue until all agree or 12 rounds
stopping_expressions.restate: Stop when (unanimous == true) OR (rounds >= 12). Owner phrasing: argue until all agree or 12 rounds. Goal id: G2.

stopping_expressions.phrasing: 90 percent consensus with a mandatory minority report
stopping_expressions.restate: Stop when (consensus_pct >= 0.90) AND (minority_report_present == true). Owner phrasing: 90 percent consensus with a mandatory minority report. Goal id: G3. A minority report is mandatory.

stopping_expressions.phrasing: continue until no new counterexample for two rounds
stopping_expressions.restate: Stop when no_new_counterexample_rounds >= 2. Owner phrasing: continue until no new counterexample for two rounds. Goal id: G4.

stopping_expressions.phrasing: stop only after an executable test settles it
stopping_expressions.restate: Stop when executable_test_settled == true. Owner phrasing: stop only after an executable test settles it. Goal id: G5.
